title: Tag Cloud
author: [url=https://github.com/tormater-yak]tormater-yak[/url]
readme: Allow users to tag their threads, and add a tag cloud to the homepage.

settings.name: Only allow these tags to be used. Leave this field empty for no restrictions, and include one tag per line. You may include a category ID number in square brackets (eg. [#3]) to whitelist tags for a specific category only.
